entry.title: Warpline 1.2.0
entry.summary: Warpline 1.2.0 for standalone MPC (MPC OS 3.x). Tested on an MPC Live III (Gen2), MPC OS 3.10.1. **New** - Wavetable picker on each oscillator (Basic Shapes, Sine, Triangle, Saw, Square, PWM, Harmonics, Formant, Sync, or the patch's own), with a big tap-to-pick menu. Init now starts on Basic Shapes. - Arpeggiator: CHANCE, DEJA VU and LOOP for generative patterns. - Mod matrix: GEN 1 and GEN 2 random sources (rate, spread, bias, steps, deja vu, length) on a new GEN page. - 60 new factory patches

entry.title: Warpline 1.1.0
entry.summary: Warpline 1.1.0: arpeggiator, GRAINZ, mod matrix, search and favourites. Tested on an MPC Live III (MPC OS 3.10.1). Projects saved with 1.0.0 open unchanged: every new setting starts at its default. ## New - **Header chips: ARP, GRAINZ, MOD.** Each chip shows its section's state; tap one to open its full-screen panel. - **Arpeggiator.** Seven modes (Up, Down, Up/Down, Down/Up, Random, As played, Chord), rates from 1/4 to 1/32 including dotted and triplet, 1-4 octaves, gate, swing, accent and latc

entry.title: Warpline 1.0.0
entry.summary: First release of Warpline: a wavetable synth for standalone MPC, built on the open-source engine of Vital (by Matt Tytel) and running as a native plugin. - Plays `.vital` patches: wavetables, LFO shapes, modulation matrix, macros, effects and tunings stored in the patch. - 300 factory patches in 14 types (made with the engine from CC0 wavetables), with a type filter and a full-screen browser. - 84 controls on six custom touchscreen pages that follow the 16 Q-Links, velocity sensitivity, Live Vie
